Bihar’s JEEViKA, the Bihar Rural Livelihoods Promotion Society (BRLPS), has completed 20 years, strengthening rural livelihoods, women’s financial inclusion and entrepreneurship through self-help groups (SHGs). Key Points Bihar Rural Livelihoods Project (JEEViKA) About: The Government of Bihar, through the Bihar Rural Livelihoods Promotion Society (BRLPS), an autonomous body under the Department of Rural Development, implements the Bihar Rural Livelihoods Project (BRLP), popularly known as JEEViKA, to promote the social and economic empowerment of rural poor. The core strategy of the BRLP programme is to build vibrant and bankable women’s community institutions in the form of self help groups (SHGs), who through member savings, internal loaning and regular repayment become self sustaining organizations. Status: JEEViKA has expanded from 6 self-help groups across 6 blocks to a statewide community network . Network Coverage : 1.81 crore households linked to 13.06 lakh SHGs. Community Institutions: 77,787 Gram Sangathans and 1,683 Cluster-Level Federations. Bank Credit: ₹76,549 crore accessed through SHGs. 6,771 Bank Sakhis facilitate banking services, financial transactions and financial awareness in rural areas. JEEViKA Didi Ki Rasoi: Promotes women’s participation in food services and institutional catering. bihar_raw_news.content: Bihar CM Samrat Choudhary Inaugurates ₹140.95 Crore Leather and Footwear Cluster in Muzaffarpur Bihar inaugurated the Mega Leather, Footwear and Accessories Cluster in Muzaffarpur, backed by ₹140.95 crore. The project features shared facilities and a Common Facility Centre to boost manufacturing, attract investment, and create local employment, with CM Choudhary outlining 2030 job targets and related infrastructure plans. India -Oneindia Staff By Oneindia Staff Published: Friday, October 16, 2026, 0:01 [IST] Add as a preferred source on Google Bihar Chief Minister Samrat Choudhary on Thursday inaugurated the Mega Leather, Footwear and Accessories Cluster at the Bihar Industrial Area Development Authority (BIADA) Industrial Area in Mahwal, Muzaffarpur. Developed at a cost of ₹140.95 crore, the project includes industrial infrastructure and a Common Facility Centre (CFC) aimed at strengthening manufacturing, attracting investment and generating employment opportunities in the state. The inauguration marks a significant step towards developing Bihar’s leather and footwear industry by providing entrepreneurs with modern infrastructure, shared facilities and better opportunities to expand their businesses. The programme was attended by Deputy Chief Minister Vijay Kumar Choudhary, Union Minister of State for Jal Shakti Raj Bhushan Choudhary, Industries Minister Shreyasi Singh, Backward Classes and Extremely Backward Classes Welfare Minister Rama Nishad, Tourism Minister Kedar Prasad Gupta, MP Veena Devi and senior government officials. The event was chaired by Industries Minister Shreyasi Singh. national_raw_news.title: 1 hour ago | National 192 SC issues notice to Congress leader Rahul Gandhi, SP chief Akhilesh Yadav over alleged SIR irregu...
national_raw_news.content: The Supreme Court today issued notice to Congress leader Rahul Gandhi and other INDIA bloc leaders on a petition raising concerns over their march to the Supreme Court and entering the court registry on October 12 to file a petition. A bench headed by Chief Justice of India (CJI) Surya Kant and Justice Joymalya Bagchi issued notices to Congress leaders Rahul Gandhi, Mallikarjun Kharge, Samajwadi Party chief Akhilesh Yadav, TMC MP Mahua Moitra, the Kerala Pradesh Congress Committee and others on a plea against the march to the top court on October 12. The bench sought the responses of Rahul Gandhi and others on a plea filed by four lawyers seeking restrictions on political demonstrations inside court premises. CJI Surya Kant observed that nobody can browbeat the top court and directed for the preservation of CCTV footage and other digital evidence relating to the incident. The Bench issued notice on the petition after senior advocate Gaurav Bhatia, appearing for the petitioners, submitted that it was unacceptable that the Supreme Court had to deal with a political procession. The petitioners have contended that political mobilisation must not be allowed to interfere with the administration of justice or create pressure on courts in matters pending adjudication. The Bench observed that such attempts were fragile and that nobody took notice of them. The protest march was undertaken by the INDIA bloc leaders towards the Supreme Court to raise concerns over the Special Intensive Revision of electoral rolls. Earlier in the day, the Supreme Court issued notice to the Election Commission of India (ECI) on a plea filed by Rahul Gandhi and 12 other INDIA bloc leaders challenging the SIR exercise. The Apex court indicated that it would examine the conduct of one of the petitioners at the next hearing. The CJI Kant-led Bench directed that the plea be tagged with other petitions already pending before the apex court challenging the validity of the SIR exercise in various states.

national_raw_news.title: 2 hours ago | Sports 53 PM Modi lauds athletes’ performances during interaction with India’s Asian Games contingent
national_raw_news.content: Prime Minister Narendra Modi today stated that India is all set to become a global sporting powerhouse. Interacting with the Indian contingent that participated in the Asian Games 2026 in New Delhi, Mr Modi lauded the Asian Games champions, saying they have made the Tricolour fly high. He said their achievements show what passion, perseverance and belief can achieve. Praising the athletes for bringing immense pride to 140 crore citizens, the Prime Minister emphasized that the ultimate achievement lies in elevating the honor and glory of the national flag. He congratulated the players, their coaches, support staff, and families for this collective national triumph. Recalling the historic milestones achieved at the Asian Games, the Prime Minister celebrated the double Gold victory of the men’s and women’s hockey teams, with the women ending a 44-year wait. He highlighted the consecutive medals for both cricket teams and dual Golds in Kabaddi. He also lauded the five Golds in archery, stellar displays in shooting, boxing, and wrestling, new athletics records, a weightlifting medal after 28 years, and the first marathon success since 1982. Youth Affairs and Sports Minister, Dr. Mansukh Mandaviya, Minister of State for Youth Affairs and Sports, Raksha Khadse and President of the Indian Olympic Association P T Usha were also present on the occasion. India finished fourth in the medal tally at the Asian Games held in Aichi-Nagoya, Japan, winning 85 medals, including 21 gold, 27 silver and 37 bronze. This marked India’s second consecutive finish among the top five nations at the Asian Games, reflecting the country’s growing competitiveness across a diverse range of sporting disciplines.

national_raw_news.title: Sports Minister reiterates need to work with greater synergy to sustain India’s sporting excellence 2 hours ago 39
national_raw_news.content: Youth Affairs and Sports Minister Dr Mansukh Mandaviya today called on National Sports Federations (NSFs) to take greater responsibility for India’s sporting performance, following the nation’s 4th place finish at the 2026 Asian Games. Interacting with NSF heads at the National Sports Federations (NSF) Conclave 2026 in New Delhi, the Minister reiterated the need to work with further synergy to sustain India’s sporting excellence. Dr. Mandaviya underlined the need to identify and develop athletes who can sustain India’s medal-winning ambitions across sporting cycles. He also emphasised the need for more sports psychologists, sports science experts and high-performance mental trainers, to mitigate the loss of focus that athletes go through when competing on major international stages. He also urged every NSF to introduce more competitions, strengthen athlete preparation, work with dedicated commitment, as well as carry out honest assessment of gaps in performance and administration. Minister of State for Youth Affairs and Sports Raksha Khadse has called for all federations to align their work with the vision of the Khelo India Mission. Ms Khadse stressed that NSFs must ensure that state and district-level federations are functioning effectively, alongside their responsibility for identifying talent. The Ministry said that the conclave served as a review of India’s Asian Games 2026 performance and a platform to assess preparations for the Los Angeles 2028 Olympics, the 2030 Commonwealth Games in Ahmedabad and the 2030 Asian Games in Doha.

national_raw_news.title: Paras Health network grows 42.5% over two years, ranks 3rd nationally - India Gazette
national_raw_news.content: Paras Health network grows 42.5% over two years, ranks 3rd nationally Paras Health network grows 42.5% over two years, ranks 3rd nationally ANI 15 Oct 2026, 13:35 GMT+10 VMPL Gurugram (Haryana) [India], October 15: IPO-bound Paras Health has been ranked joint third alongside Manipal Hospitals in the National Group Ranking 2026 for private multispeciality hospital groups. The network of eight hospitals recorded a 42.5% increase in inpatient volumes and a 31.3% rise in surgeries between FY2024 and FY2026, according to its June 2026 draft abridged prospectus. Apollo Hospitals placed first and Fortis Healthcare second. The survey assessed eligible groups as integrated networks, so Paras's position applies to the group as a whole rather than to individual hospitals. The ranking comes as organised private hospital chains expand through new facilities, additional beds and acquisitions. ICRA's July 2026 update projected revenue growth of 13-15% in FY2027 for its sample of hospital companies, following 18% growth in FY2026. Separately, Crisil Ratings' February assessment of 98 private hospitals forecast more than 10,000 bed additions through new facilities and expansions of existing hospitals across FY2026 and FY2027. Expansion is taking place alongside improving financial coverage and continuing pressure on households. The government's 2025 health survey found insurance or financing-scheme coverage had reached 47.4% in rural India and 44.3% in urban areas. National Health Accounts estimates for FY2022-23, released in May 2026, show households still paid 43.4% of total health expenditure directly. For hospital networks, these figures underline the importance of affordability and access alongside increasing capacity. ( pib.gov.in , pib.gov.in ) Hospital chains also face the task of recruiting and retaining specialist doctors and nurses, developing referral systems and maintaining reliable diagnostics. As networks grow, providers must balance spending on clinical teams, equipment and new facilities with the need to keep treatment accessible and sustain standards across locations. Dr Dharminder Kumar Nagar, Managing Director, Paras Health, said, "Sharing third place in the national hospital group ranking is an important milestone for Paras Health. Our growth in inpatient volumes and surgeries brings a responsibility to strengthen the clinical teams and infrastructure supporting that care. We are focused on building specialist capabilities and critical care capacity across our hospitals, while maintaining consistent standards as more patients use our network." Paras's inpatient volumes reached 115,496 in FY2026, compared with 81,047 in FY2024. The filing counts patients admitted and subsequently discharged during the relevant period. Surgeries increased to 39,687 from 30,219, while outpatient consultation visits rose 36.8% to 778,707 from 569,139 over the same two years. Revenue from operations increased 24.1% year on year to approximately 1,606 crore in FY2026 from 1,294 crore in FY2025. The group reported a consolidated profit after tax of 43.83 crore in FY2026, compared with a loss of 57.98 crore a year earlier. Overall bed occupancy rose to 61.75% in FY2026 from 52.46% in FY2024. As of March 31, 2026, Paras reported 1,502 operational beds, up from 1,332 two years earlier. ICU beds increased to 559 from 425 over the same period. These figures...

national_raw_news.title: MoD inks Rs 4,106 crore contracts for GSAT-7C communication satellite and Varunastra ...
national_raw_news.content: MoD inks Rs 4,106 crore contracts for GSAT-7C communication satellite and Varunastra Heavy Weight Torpedoes Toggle navigation हिंदी खबर MoD inks Rs 4,106 crore contracts for GSAT-7C communication satellite and Varunastra Heavy Weight Torpedoes ANI | Updated: Oct 15, 2026 18:55 IST ANI News Join our Whatsapp channel New Delhi [India], October 15 (ANI): The Ministry of Defence has signed contracts worth a total of approximately Rs 4,106 crore for the acquisition of a dedicated communication satellite capability, GSAT-7C for the Indian Air Force, and Varunastra Heavy Weight Torpedoes for the Indian Navy . The contract for GSAT-7C, valued at Rs 2,563 crore, was inked with New Space India Limited, Bengaluru. This indigenously designed, developed & manufactured satellite will enhance the secure, resilient & seamless communication capabilities for the assets of the Indian Air Force, thereby strengthening operational effectiveness, said the Ministry of Defence . The contract for Varunastra was signed with Bharat Dynamics Limited, Hyderabad worth Rs 1,543 crore. Varunastra is an indigenous ship-launched anti-submarine torpedo developed by the Naval Science and Technological Laboratory. Equipped with advanced maneuvering capabilities, it is capable of engaging enemy submarines at long ranges, thereby enhancing the anti-submarine warfare capability of the Indian Navy . The contracts were signed in the presence of Additional Secretary and Director General (Acquisition), Department of Defence A Anbarasu in New Delhi on October 15, 2026. Both contracts mark a significant step towards advancing the development of domestic defence manufacturing capabilities while promoting self-reliance in critical technologies in line with the Government’s ‘Aatmanirbhar Bharat’ and ‘Make-in-India’ vision. Last week, the Ministry of Defence signed a contract with BrahMos Aerospace Private Limited (BAPL) for procurement of BrahMos Fire Control System and Launchers for Indian Navy ships under the Buy (Indian-IDDM) Category, on Monday in New Delhi. According to a release from the Ministry of Defence , valued at Rs 661.50 crore, the contract was inked in the presence of Defence Secretary Rajesh Kumar Singh. With a minimum of 68% indigenous content, the project encourages active participation of various Indian industries, including MSMEs. The project will generate employment over a period of three years. It also bolsters India’s maritime security architecture and defence capabilities and marks a critical milestone in the ongoing efforts to indigenise advanced military technology.
